title: The role of the SOX2 gene in cervical cancer: focus on ferroptosis and construction of a predictive model.
authors: Liu, Shenping; Wei, Zhi; Ding, Huiqing
journal: Journal of cancer research and clinical oncology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SOX2基因在宫颈癌中与铁死亡的关系及预后模型构建，属于纯临床/表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无结合建模、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The intricate interplay between stemness markers and cell death pathways significantly influences the pathophysiology of cervical cancer. SOX2, a pivotal regulator of stem cell pluripotency, has recently been implicated in the modulation of ferroptosis, a specialized form of iron-dependent cell death, in cancer dynamics. This study delineates the role of SOX2 in the ferroptotic landscape of cervical carcinoma. OBJECTIVE: To delineate the association between SOX2 expression and ferroptosis in cervical cancer and develop a robust, SOX2-centric model for predicting prognosis and enhancing personalized treatment. METHODS: A multidimensional approach integrating advanced bioinformatics, comprehensive molecular profiling, and state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms was employed to assess SOX2 expression patterns and their correlation with ferroptosis marker expression patterns in cervical cancer tissues. A prognostic model incorporating the expression levels of SOX2 and ferroptosis indicators was meticulously constructed. RESULTS: This investigation revealed a profound and intricate correlation between SOX2 expression and ferroptotic processes in cervical cancer, substantiated by robust molecular evidence. The developed predictive model based on SOX2 expression exhibited superior prognostic accuracy and may guide therapeutic decision-making. CONCLUSION: This study underscores the critical role of SOX2 in orchestrating the ferroptosis pathway in cervical cancer and presents a novel prognostic framework. The SOX2-centric predictive model represents a significant advancement in prognosis evaluation, offering a gateway to personalized treatment for gynaecologic cancers.
abstract_zh: 背景：干性标志物与细胞死亡通路之间的复杂相互作用显著影响宫颈癌的病理生理学。SOX2作为干细胞多能性的关键调控因子，近期被发现在癌症动态中参与调节铁死亡（ferroptosis），一种铁依赖性细胞死亡的特殊形式。本研究阐明了SOX2在宫颈癌铁死亡景观中的作用。目的：明确SOX2表达与宫颈癌中铁死亡之间的关联，并构建一个以SOX2为核心的稳健模型，用于预测预后和增强个性化治疗。方法：采用整合先进生物信息学、全面分子谱分析和最先进机器学习算法的多维方法，评估宫颈癌组织中SOX2表达模式及其与铁死亡标志物表达模式的相关性。精心构建了一个包含SOX2和铁死亡指标表达水平的预后模型。结果：本研究发现SOX2表达与宫颈癌铁死亡过程之间存在深刻而复杂的相关性，并得到稳健分子证据的支持。基于SOX2表达开发的预测模型展现出优越的预后准确性，可能指导治疗决策。结论：本研究强调了SOX2在调控宫颈癌铁死亡通路中的关键作用，并提出了一种新型预后框架。以SOX2为核心的预测模型代表了预后评估的重大进展，为妇科癌症的个性化治疗提供了途径。
